name: lakeformation
description: Lake Formation Defines the public endpoint for the Lake Formation service.

subcommands.name: add-lf-tags-to-resource
subcommands.description: Attaches one or more LF-tags to an existing resource.

subcommands.name: assume-decorated-role-with-saml
subcommands.description: Allows a caller to assume an IAM role decorated as the SAML user specified in the SAML assertion included in the request.

subcommands.name: batch-grant-permissions
subcommands.description: Batch operation to grant permissions to the principal.

subcommands.name: batch-revoke-permissions
subcommands.description: Batch operation to revoke permissions from the principal.

subcommands.name: cancel-transaction
subcommands.description: Attempts to cancel the specified transaction.

subcommands.name: commit-transaction
subcommands.description: Attempts to commit the specified transaction.

subcommands.name: create-data-cells-filter
subcommands.description: Creates a data cell filter to allow one to grant access to certain columns on certain rows.

subcommands.name: create-lake-formation-identity-center-configuration
subcommands.description: Creates an IAM Identity Center connection with Lake Formation to allow IAM Identity Center users and groups to access Data Catalog resources.

subcommands.name: create-lake-formation-opt-in
subcommands.description: Enforce Lake Formation permissions for the given databases, tables, and principals.

subcommands.name: create-lf-tag
subcommands.description: Creates an LF-tag with the specified name and values.

subcommands.name: create-lf-tag-expression
subcommands.description: Creates a new LF-Tag expression with the provided name, description, catalog ID, and expression body.

subcommands.name: delete-data-cells-filter
subcommands.description: Deletes a data cell filter.

subcommands.name: delete-lake-formation-identity-center-configuration
subcommands.description: Deletes an IAM Identity Center connection with Lake Formation.

subcommands.name: delete-lake-formation-opt-in
subcommands.description: Remove the Lake Formation permissions enforcement of the given databases, tables, and principals.

subcommands.name: delete-lf-tag
subcommands.description: Deletes an LF-tag by its key name.

subcommands.name: delete-lf-tag-expression
subcommands.description: Deletes the LF-Tag expression.

subcommands.name: delete-objects-on-cancel
subcommands.description: For a specific governed table, provides a list of Amazon S3 objects that will be written during the current transaction and that can be automatically deleted if the transaction is canceled.

subcommands.name: deregister-resource
subcommands.description: Deregisters the resource as managed by the Data Catalog.

subcommands.name: describe-lake-formation-identity-center-configuration
subcommands.description: Retrieves the instance ARN and application ARN for the connection.

subcommands.name: describe-resource
subcommands.description: Retrieves the current data access role for the given resource registered in Lake Formation.

subcommands.name: describe-transaction
subcommands.description: Returns the details of a single transaction.

subcommands.name: extend-transaction
subcommands.description: Indicates to the service that the specified transaction is still active and should not be treated as idle and aborted.

subcommands.name: get-data-cells-filter
subcommands.description: Returns a data cells filter.

subcommands.name: get-data-lake-principal
subcommands.description: Returns the identity of the invoking principal.

subcommands.name: get-data-lake-settings
subcommands.description: Retrieves the list of the data lake administrators of a Lake Formation-managed data lake.

subcommands.name: get-effective-permissions-for-path
subcommands.description: Returns the Lake Formation permissions for a specified table or database resource located at a path in Amazon S3.

subcommands.name: get-lf-tag
subcommands.description: Returns an LF-tag definition.

subcommands.name: get-lf-tag-expression
subcommands.description: Returns the details about the LF-Tag expression.

subcommands.name: get-query-state
subcommands.description: Returns the state of a query previously submitted.

subcommands.name: get-query-statistics
subcommands.description: Retrieves statistics on the planning and execution of a query.

subcommands.name: get-resource-lf-tags
subcommands.description: Returns the LF-tags applied to a resource.

subcommands.name: get-table-objects
subcommands.description: Returns the set of Amazon S3 objects that make up the specified governed table.

subcommands.name: get-temporary-data-location-credentials
subcommands.description: Allows a user or application in a secure environment to access data in a specific Amazon S3 location registered with Lake Formation by providing temporary scoped credentials that are limited to the requested data location and the caller's authorized access level.

subcommands.name: get-temporary-glue-partition-credentials
subcommands.description: This API is identical to GetTemporaryTableCredentials except that this is used when the target Data Catalog resource is of type Partition.

subcommands.name: get-temporary-glue-table-credentials
subcommands.description: Allows a caller in a secure environment to assume a role with permission to access Amazon S3.

subcommands.name: get-work-unit-results
subcommands.description: Returns the work units resulting from the query.

subcommands.name: get-work-units
subcommands.description: Retrieves the work units generated by the StartQueryPlanning operation.

subcommands.name: grant-permissions
subcommands.description: Grants permissions to the principal to access metadata in the Data Catalog and data organized in underlying data storage such as Amazon S3.

subcommands.name: list-data-cells-filter
subcommands.description: Lists all the data cell filters on a table.

subcommands.name: list-lake-formation-opt-ins
subcommands.description: Retrieve the current list of resources and principals that are opt in to enforce Lake Formation permissions.

subcommands.name: list-lf-tag-expressions
subcommands.description: Returns the LF-Tag expressions in caller’s account filtered based on caller's permissions.

subcommands.name: list-lf-tags
subcommands.description: Lists LF-tags that the requester has permission to view.

subcommands.name: list-permissions
subcommands.description: Returns a list of the principal permissions on the resource, filtered by the permissions of the caller.

subcommands.name: list-resources
subcommands.description: Lists the resources registered to be managed by the Data Catalog.

subcommands.name: list-table-storage-optimizers
subcommands.description: Returns the configuration of all storage optimizers associated with a specified table.

subcommands.name: list-transactions
subcommands.description: Returns metadata about transactions and their status.

subcommands.name: put-data-lake-settings
subcommands.description: Sets the list of data lake administrators who have admin privileges on all resources managed by Lake Formation.

subcommands.name: register-resource
subcommands.description: Registers the resource as managed by the Data Catalog.

subcommands.name: remove-lf-tags-from-resource
subcommands.description: Removes an LF-tag from the resource.

subcommands.name: revoke-permissions
subcommands.description: Revokes permissions to the principal to access metadata in the Data Catalog and data organized in underlying data storage such as Amazon S3.

subcommands.name: search-databases-by-lf-tags
subcommands.description: This operation allows a search on DATABASE resources by TagCondition.

subcommands.name: search-tables-by-lf-tags
subcommands.description: This operation allows a search on TABLE resources by LFTags.

subcommands.name: start-query-planning
subcommands.description: Submits a request to process a query statement.

subcommands.name: start-transaction
subcommands.description: Starts a new transaction and returns its transaction ID.

subcommands.name: update-data-cells-filter
subcommands.description: Updates a data cell filter.

subcommands.name: update-lake-formation-identity-center-configuration
subcommands.description: Updates the IAM Identity Center connection parameters.

subcommands.name: update-lf-tag
subcommands.description: Updates the list of possible values for the specified LF-tag key.

subcommands.name: update-lf-tag-expression
subcommands.description: Updates the name of the LF-Tag expression to the new description and expression body provided.

subcommands.name: update-resource
subcommands.description: Updates the data access role used for vending access to the given (registered) resource in Lake Formation.

subcommands.name: update-table-objects
subcommands.description: Updates the manifest of Amazon S3 objects that make up the specified governed table.

subcommands.name: update-table-storage-optimizer
subcommands.description: Updates the configuration of the storage optimizers for a table.
